newsitem.title: USA: In Focus sees Q3 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: In Focus sees Q3 below estimates.

text.p: In Focus Systems Inc said on Monday it expects third quarter earnings to fall short of analysts' estimates.
The company cited insufficient supply of a key component for a new product, capital constraints in the channel, and continued aggressive price competition on VGA projection products.
According to First Call, analysts expect the company to report a profit of $0.30 a share for the third quarter, down from $0.53 a year ago.

"The most significant limiting factor in the quarter has come from a key supplier who just notified us that due to yield problems, it is unlikely they will be able to keep their previous commitments for component parts to meet our initial production ramp for a new projector, resulting in our inability to satisfy shippable backlog," the company said. "Accordingly, we will ship fewer units for revenue than originally planned in the quarter."
"Demand for our newly released projector products has been strong in recent weeks as dealers come off holiday, particularly in Europe," the company added.

"However, revenue growth will slow in the quarter due to a number of our resellers being on credit hold status, as they await payment on the sell-through of LitePro 580s they had in inventory earlier in the quarter," it said.
In addition, In Focus continues to face ongoing price competition, particularly for VGA projection systems, as new competitors enter the market.

"As a result, gross margins will probably be lower than originally anticipated in analyst forecast estimates for the quarter," the company said. "However, we will return to profitability this quarter, and we remain optimistic about our future growth and profitability as demand continues to grow." In Focus devlops, manufactures and markets multimedia projection products and services to present video, audio, graphics and data from personal computers and other electronic devices.
